units.translation: ⟦1⟧ is immunity from all burdens, such as the descendants of Harmodius already had in Athens at that time; likewise, ⟦2⟧ is an expression of political life, a preliminary investigation, which in Athens belonged to the archon, the basileus, etc. for their judicial sphere, while the decision was taken away from them (⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧). Thus = ⟦5⟧ (⟦6⟧) ⟦7⟧.
not even to come to a preliminary inquiry

⟦1⟧ as ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧; cf. on the apocope above at 243. It further follows that in v. 366 the ⟦4⟧ after ⟦5⟧ is to be deleted with f g h (thus not, for instance, to write in the strophe ⟦6⟧⟨⟦7⟧⟩⟦8⟧); the conjunction could easily have been inserted by someone who did not understand the sentence construction (⟦9⟧ at first; then written above); so it also happened at v. 378. ⟦10⟧ was long ago (by Bothe) emended to ⟦11⟧ (⟦12⟧), cf. ⟦13⟧ Frg. 230, ⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧. Dindorf takes offense at ⟦16⟧ because this is the only compound with ⟦17⟧- in Aeschylus and from the other tragedians only ⟦18⟧ (⟦19⟧), ⟦20⟧ (Hipp. 1465), ⟦21⟧ (⟦22⟧) are added, whereas later these formations appear abundantly, as in Xenophon. Furthermore, also because it would have to be formed from ⟦23⟧ -⟦24⟧, like ⟦25⟧ 644.

⟦1⟧ could now be written; but the suspicion that the whole word is an explanation for a genuine one holds one back; also -⟦2⟧ -⟦3⟧ is prettier than -⟦4⟧ -⟦5⟧ would be. Dindorf now uses force not only here, but also in the corresponding verse of the strophe: ⟦6⟧ – ⟦7⟧; that was his manner of rewriting, which rightly no one follows anymore. I have set a cross; according to the strophe ⟦8⟧ lies near, which stands in Xenophon Cyr. III, 1, 9 (with intensifying ⟦9⟧); the opposite ⟦10⟧ Aeschylus has ⟦11⟧.
but of white robes I alone was made without share
for Zeus has made this whole race blood-defiled, apart from the assemblies
⟦1⟧ class of people (⟦2⟧ Schol.) like ⟦3⟧ Aeschylus. Anapaests and first stasimon. (likewise Plato, Xenophon);

⟦1⟧ intercourse, conversation also ⟦2⟧ according to Emperius for ⟦3⟧ (which has remained in my text by mistake); ⟦4⟧ suus according to ⟦5⟧; ⟦6⟧ middle only here (-⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧; Thucydides and others); but likewise 425 ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧.
The ⟦1⟧' at the beginning of the new thought does not correspond to usage; therefore ⟦2⟧' with Bergk.
